list_projects.title: List Godot Projects
description: Lists the Godot projects that are available to open.
When the MCP is running with --global, this includes the projects registered in the project manager and those under the project base path.
Otherwise, this recursively searches the allowed root paths.

projects.description: The Godot projects that were found

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

project_name.description: The project's configured name; omitted if it couldn't be read

open_godot_project.title: Open Godot Project
open_godot_project.description: Opens a Godot project in a new Godot editor instance, if it isn't already open.

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

headless.description: Launch the editor without visual or audio output (default: false). This won't have an effect if the editor is already open for this project.

success.description: True if the project was already open, or a new editor instance was started for it

list_open_projects.title: List Open Godot Projects
list_open_projects.description: Lists the projects currently open in a Godot editor.

projects.description: The projects that are currently open in a Godot editor

project_path.description: The absolute path to the project directory

project_name.description: The project's configured name; omitted if it couldn't be read

get_godai_settings.title: Get Godai Settings
description: Gets Godai's own settings, which configure Godai itself rather than anything inside the Godot project or editor.
Only the settings that can be changed at runtime are included; the rest come from command-line arguments.

godot_path.description: The full path to the Godot 4 executable; empty if none is configured

project_base_path.description: The base path where the user's Godot projects live; always empty unless MCP is running with --global

set_godai_settings.title: Set Godai Settings
description: Changes Godai's own settings, which configure Godai itself rather than anything inside the Godot project or editor.
Only the settings that can be changed at runtime can be set here; the rest come from command-line arguments.
Use get_godai_settings to see the current values.

godot_path.description: The full path to the Godot 4 executable

project_base_path.description: The base path where the user's Godot projects live; can only be set when MCP is running with --global

success.description: True if the settings were changed and saved
